theme: GnIES against gnies 0.3.3, the authors' package; UT-IGSP against graphical-model-learning 0.1a8, the authors' library
build: GnIES: Andrey pre-release build of 3 November 2026 (version string 0.13.0) for every fit but the order check, which ran on a build of the same day that adds DEBUG records of the steps a tie decided; with the records off, its GIES and GES outputs equal the first build's | UT-IGSP: Andrey pre-release build of 3 November 2026 (version string 0.13.0) for Andrey's fits; the reference's fits ran in an earlier job on the same data, which the build regenerated identically
verdict_rule: GnIES: per cell and per metric (shd, target_error), D = error(Andrey at its defaults) - error(gnies at its defaults) per dataset, on datasets both finished and the model check passed; worse when the 95% percentile-bootstrap interval of mean D lies entirely above 0, better when entirely below, a tie otherwise; fewer than 10 pairs is reported, not judged. 10,000 resamples of the datasets, the generator seeded by the CRC-32 of '<cell>/<metric>/<comparison>'. A worse cell counts only if its rerun on seeds 20-39 is worse too; a better cell is cited only if its rerun is better too. Floors: in every cell with 100 or more rows per environment, the interval of shd(Andrey) - shd(empty) and of target_error(Andrey) - |true targets| must lie entirely below 0; in a cell with 10 rows per environment the shd floor applies only when the reference's own interval against the empty graph lies entirely below 0, and the target-error floor does not apply. Out-of-claim cells are reported and never judged | UT-IGSP: per cell, row, and metric (shd, target_error): D = error(Andrey) - error(reference) per dataset, each the mean over 5 draws; side = where the 95% percentile bootstrap interval of mean D (10,000 resamples) lies; worse = above 0 on seeds 0-19 and on the rerun on seeds 2000-2019; better = below 0 on seeds 0-19 and on a second set (seeds 2000-2019, or for J2 the confirmation's seeds 4000-4019); a row with both is better when either lies below 0 (one row: J2 G2_perfect_l1_n1000 shd, below 0 on 2000-2019, contains 0 on 4000-4019); otherwise the row is named by its side on seeds 0-19 and 'not replicated', or 'tie'. Seeds 4000-4019 are the seeds on which J2's default was chosen, as the setting with the most rows below 0 there, so they favor below 0 for J2: 17 of J2's 18 better rows repeated there, 1 on seeds 2000-2019. In a row, multi_draw holds the interval on seeds 0-19, side its side, replication the rerun on seeds 2000-2019, confirmation the rerun on seeds 4000-4019, and verdict the result; out of claim, verdict is the side
fit_protocol: GnIES: every arm of a dataset back to back on one pinned core with one BLAS thread; a cap of 1,800 s per fit at 10 variables (300 s for gnies with the true targets fixed) and 3,600 s on the variable ladder; a fit past its cap is a timeout, never an empty graph; a gnies fit whose total is not finite or whose local scores returned NaN is an error and leaves its cell's pairs | UT-IGSP: every package of a dataset in its own child process pinned to one core with one BLAS thread; 5 draws per dataset in claim (Andrey seed 0-4, the library's Python random and NumPy global generator seeded 0-4), one out of claim; a cap of 1,800 s per draw (3,600 s at 100 variables and with kernel tests), a timeout never scored
error_metric: GnIES: each entry's own, in its error_metric and metric: the SHD of the interventional essential graph or the target error, as the median over the paired datasets (the _mean fields hold the means) | UT-IGSP: each entry's own, in its error_metric and metric: the SHD of the interventional essential graph or the target error, as the median over the paired datasets of each dataset's mean over its draws (the _mean fields hold the means)
complete_definition: GnIES: true when every setting has at least 10 paired datasets (both packages finished); a setting with fewer is listed in incomplete, its timeouts counted in the timeout columns and never scored | UT-IGSP: true when every setting has at least 10 paired datasets (both packages finished); a setting with fewer is listed in incomplete, its timeouts counted in the timeout columns and never scored
seeds_note: GnIES: seeds is the number of datasets attempted per setting: 20 (seeds 0-19) in every in-claim and out-of-claim setting at 10 variables, with reruns on seeds 20-39 in the replication of the 7 settings that came out better; 10 (seeds 0-9) on the ladder of 20 to 100 variables, where the reference ran 10 seeds at 20 variables, 3 at 30, and none at 50 and 100 | UT-IGSP: seeds is the number of datasets attempted per setting: 20 (seeds 0-19), 10 (seeds 0-9) at 50 and 100 variables; 5 draws per dataset in claim, 1 out of claim; reruns on seeds 2000-2019 in the 11 in-claim cells with a comparison above 0 in the first comparison, and, at the defaults, the confirmation's seeds 4000-4019 in every in-claim cell. Categorical data (Andrey alone) is in the lane file only

residue_note: a side is read after rounding the interval's ends to 10 decimals: three ends are floating-point residue of an exact 0 (5e-18 and -6e-18 in the final rows J2 G1_shift_l3_n3000 shd and J1 G6_weight_l0_n1000 target_error, 2e-17 in the confirmation's a1e-05_lexicographic_s10 G2_perfect_l1_n1000 shd), so those intervals touch 0 and the rows tie; the run's own scripts read them as above or below 0, which changed no decision. The same reading moves the first of them from above 0 to contains 0 in default_selection.trace.inv_n_sum_counts.
